description: This file defines a PHP interface 'EndpointResult' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2' namespace. It specifies method signatures for normalizing objects and retrieving metadata and relationships, serving as a contract for API endpoint result representations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Prepares the endpoint result object as an associative array for output or processing.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the associated metadata as a ParameterBag object or null.

methods.name: getRels
methods.description: Returns the relationships data as a ParameterBag object or null.
